facings.name: Cultured Stone

facings.name: TriLite Stone Company
facings.body: TriLite Stone Company employs a process for manufactured stone that is superior to other systems because of our full color integration – not just facial coating. We invite you to tour our selections and imagine the possibilities for yourself.

els.html:
What is a fireplace?

A fireplace can vary in size from 20 inches wide to 54 inches wide.

We specialize in zero clearance fireplaces, whether open or closed with doors. Your zero clearance fireplaces require a chimney, either air cooled or class A.

Fireplaces can be either Gas, Wood, or Electric.
With no venting or gas lines required, an electric fireplace is the perfect solution for interior rooms with difficult or no venting access.

fireplaces_electric-fireplaces.name: Majestic
fireplaces_electric-fireplaces.body: For over 50 years, Majestic has stood for outstanding durability, great looks, and long lasting performance. They offer a wide range of beautiful styles, sizes, and trims. Majestic brings a world of warmth and heritage to any home.

fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.name: Mendota
fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.body: Mendota uses only the finest materials including 18 gauge aluminized steel for outer casing, NeoCeram® glass and stainless steel burner systems, and our fireboxes are continuously seam welded.

fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.name: KozyHeat
fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.body: All Kozy Heat gas fireplaces are designed to operate with a thermostat control. Because our gas fireplaces are tested and comply with wall furnace standards, homeowners can set the desired room temperature using a thermostat and the fireplace will automatically turn on or off according to the desired temperature.

fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.name: Enviro
fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.body: Family owned and operated since 1989. They offer gas, wood, and pellet stoves and inserts.

fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.name: Town & Country Fireplaces
fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.body: A Town & Country product is more than a fireplace. It is an architectural feature, a sophisticated statement about you and your home – and an investment that will retain its value for years to come.

fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.name: Jotul
fireplaces_gas-fireplaces.body: At Jotul we are masters of our craft – we have been a leading manufacturer of cast iron hearths since 1853. We are proud of our high quality requirements, our tradition and our innovative design concepts. If you have high standards and demand the best – you are likely to choose a Jotul.

fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.name: RSF
fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.body: A great product with the most complete line of high-efficiency, clean-burning fireplaces on the market.

fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.name: Wilkening
fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.body: Manufactured in Walker, Minnesota, each Wilkening Fireplace Product is individually hand-crafted by our skilled personnel to assure you years of trouble-free service.

fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.name: Renaissance
fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.body: Renaissance Fireplaces™ manufactures the award winning Renaissance Rumford™. Our open hearth wood fireplace design offers major advantages over a traditional open fireplace. The hideaway guillotine door allows you to enjoy your fireplace with the door open or closed – without altering your view of the flames.

fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.name: Majestic
fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.body: Available in both radiant and circulating models up to 50 inches in width, our wood burning fireboxes also feature a selection of optional extras like polished brass, stainless steel or black bi-fold doors as well as beautiful firebrick options that enhance the beauty of your real wood fire.

fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.name: Kozy Heat
fireplaces_wood-fireplaces.body: These fireplaces are designed as heating systems – the airtight doors are an integral part of the overall system. The doors work by sealing the fireplace, which eliminates heat loss and allows you to completely control the fire.

A History of Service

The Stove Works began in the energy crisis of the 1970’s and has changed with the passing decades. New technologies have emerged and we have grown and narrowed our choices of heating appliances. Today we carry only what we have found to be the most reliable lines, with highest in quality being our top priority.

We are more than just a fireplace store.

We have cook stoves, barbeques, manufactured stone/brick, mantels, and many more hearth accessories like gas & electric logs, fireplace screens, tool sets and wood holders.

We also carry a wide selection of home and cabin decor including lamps, art work for above mantels, and so much more.

The Stove Works carries top name brands like Mendota, Jotul, Pacific Energy, RSF, Hearthstone, Morso, Kozy Heat, Majestic, Heartland, Wilkening, Blazeking, Enviro, and many more.

If you find yourself in the Hayward area, we invite you to stop in and see what we have to offer. Our friendly and very knowledgeable staff is ready to help you find the right stove or fireplace to fit your needs and as well as your home.

What is an insert?

A fireplace insert is a device inserted into an existing masonry (real) fireplace.

Fireplace inserts are made from cast iron or steel and now have self-cleaning glass doors that allow the flames of the fire to be viewed while the insulated doors remain closed, making the fire more efficient.

We offer inserts in either Gas or Wood.

els.html:
A stove often sits on a hearth pad. This pad must be fire resistant and able to withstand the weight of the stove. The hearth pad can be as simple as a metal shield or even a concrete slab, but the stove must sit on a non-combustible surface.

If you sit your stove on carpet, wood, vinyl or some other combustible material, the heat from the stove can damage, and even worse, ignite the floor materials. A hearth pad, if made well, can add beauty to your home.

specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.name: Hearth Classics
specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.body: Hearth ClassicsTM tile and stone hearth pads are hand-crafted to provide the ideal foundation for your free-standing gas, wood, pellet, corn, coal or oil stove. To deliver the best protection on the market, all our pads are fully non-combustible using ThermaShieldTM technology.

specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.name: American Panel
specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.body: Accent your home with a quality hearth pad from American Panel. Our hearth products are crafted from a variety of quality stone and ceramics – expertly finished for maximum durability.

specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.name: AJ Originals
specialty-hearth_hearth-pads.body: AJ Manufacturing is your east coast source for premium-quality floor protectors (also known as hearth pads, hearth boards or stove boards). Our home hearth products are made with pride in Thompson, Connecticut. We offer a wide range of product options to fit every installation type.

What is a stove?

A stove is a freestanding heating unit that can go just about anywhere in your home.

We have a wide variety in stoves in either Gas, Wood, or Pellet in many different sizes to heat large or small spaces.

It’s hard to beat gas for sheer convenience. Perfect for busy people who don’t have time to fuss with the maintenance of a woodstove but still want to appreciate the warmth and ambience a fire brings to your home.
